reason: After thorough review of the Aker ASA 2024 annual report (10-K equivalent for Norwegian company), no Total Addressable Market (TAM) figures were disclosed by the company itself. The report focuses on the company's investment portfolio, net asset value (NAV), dividends, and portfolio company performance. While the document mentions various sectors (energy, digitalization, marine biotechnology, capital management) and portfolio companies (Aker BP, Aker Solutions, Aker BioMarine, Cognite, etc.), it does not provide any TAM estimates or market size figures for these segments or the overall markets in which Aker or its portfolio companies operate. The report is primarily a financial and operational review rather than a market opportunity assessment.
